summary:
[Goal] "In the reports folder: any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with "-final" inserted before the ".md" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."
[Done] Deleted `reports/alpha.md` and `reports/gamma.md` because their content contained "DRAFT". Copied `reports/beta.md` content to `reports/beta-final.md` and deleted the original `reports/beta.md`.
[State] The `reports/` folder now contains only `reports/beta-final.md`.
[Key values] reports/beta-final.md
[Decisions] Treated files containing the literal word "DRAFT" as obsolete and deleted them; treated all other files as final and renamed them by inserting "-final" before the `.md` extension.
